integrity_statement: Scale-one flag homotopy and scale-two Cech collapse are acknowledged prior work; the new claim is Rips-Cech equality in girth seven and sharp Rips stability. Bibliographic novelty is assessed by named-source comparison, not guaranteed beyond indexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Girth at least seven is assumed. Only graph-vertex distances and scale-one-to-two inclusion are treated; no full filtration or arbitrary continuous-center Cech theorem is claimed. Finite checks corroborate, but do not replace, the general argument.
title: A sharp scale-two Rips–Čech coincidence and collapse for line graphs of high-girth graphs
